summary: Thiscall string sanitizer: walks the input string in place. First pass replaces path separator characters ('.', '/', '\') with underscore '_' (ASCII 95). Second pass replaces any character where StringPrefixPatternCheck returns nonzero with hyphen '-' (ASCII 45). Both passes are skipped when the string pointer or its first byte is null. Used by profile/path handling to sanitize strings for use as file or directory names.

operations.description: Guard on the this pointer: when it is null the function does nothing.
Guard on the first byte of the string (field this+0x0): when it is NUL both iteration passes are skipped.
First pass: do-while iteration over every character of the string from the first byte (field this+0x0) until the NUL terminator.
Per-character guard (packet guard 0, this+0x0): character value >= 46 (0x2E) and (<= 47 or == 92), which selects '.' (46), '/' (47) and '\' (92).
Replace the matched path separator character in-place with ASCII 95 ('_').
Second pass: do-while iteration over every character of the string from the first byte (field this+0x0) until the NUL terminator.
Call StringPrefixPatternCheck (0x005685B0) on the current character position; a nonzero return selects that character for hyphen replacement.
Replace the matched character in-place with ASCII 45 ('-').
Called by ProfileAlreadyExistsPageHandler (0x0046CB50) and PathBuilderWithBackslash (0x0046E600) to sanitize strings into safe file/directory names.

unresolved: Semantics of StringPrefixPatternCheck (which prefix patterns select the hyphen replacement) are not present in this packet.
The two passes can both act on the same character; the exact interplay between underscore and hyphen replacement is not resolved.
